artifact_observations.reasoning: Significant motion blur is present on the throwing arm. While this mimics real-world photography of fast motion, AI generators often struggle to render naturalistic motion blur, sometimes resulting in 'smearing' rather than directional blur. Here it looks plausible but slightly soft/unstructured at the edges.

The letters on the chest appear slightly fused into the fabric texture rather than sitting crisply on top. The edges of the 'E' and 'T' show minor bleeding into the white jersey material, a common AI artifact in text rendering on cloth.

The connection between the wrist and the glove is somewhat ambiguous. The fingers of the glove seem to merge slightly with the sleeve cuff, lacking clear separation of individual leather segments or distinct wrist anatomy.
